title: Riptide - Flow Forensics
description: Show me exactly the flows matching this slice — who, what service, how much, and the raw records. Investigation surface over the flows table: every filter (tenant, zone, exporter, application, L4 protocol, source/destination address and port) is optional and they combine with AND; an empty box or 'All' means no constraint on that dimension. Start wide, tighten one filter at a time until only the traffic in question remains, then read the raw records at the bottom. Click a host in the tables to set it as the Source or Destination filter — the whole dashboard tightens to it in place.

list.name: database
list.label: Database

query.rawSql: SELECT DISTINCT database FROM system.tables WHERE name = 'flows'

list.definition: SELECT DISTINCT database FROM system.tables WHERE name = 'flows'

list.name: tenant
list.label: Tenant

query.rawSql: SELECT DISTINCT tenant FROM ${database}.flows ORDER BY tenant

list.definition: SELECT DISTINCT tenant FROM ${database}.flows ORDER BY tenant

list.name: zone
list.label: Zone

query.rawSql: SELECT DISTINCT zone FROM ${database}.flows ORDER BY zone

list.definition: SELECT DISTINCT zone FROM ${database}.flows ORDER BY zone

list.name: exporter
list.label: Exporter

query.rawSql: SELECT exporterAddr AS __value, if(argMax(exporterName, receivedAt) != '', argMax(exporterName, receivedAt), exporterAddr) AS __text FROM ${database}.flows GROUP BY exporterAddr ORDER BY __text

list.definition: SELECT exporterAddr AS __value, if(argMax(exporterName, receivedAt) != '', argMax(exporterName, receivedAt), exporterAddr) AS __text FROM ${database}.flows GROUP BY exporterAddr ORDER BY __text

list.name: application
list.label: Application

query.rawSql: SELECT DISTINCT ifNull(application, 'unclassified') AS application FROM ${database}.flows ORDER BY application

list.definition: SELECT DISTINCT ifNull(application, 'unclassified') AS application FROM ${database}.flows ORDER BY application

list.name: l4
list.label: L4 protocol
list.query: TCP : 6, UDP : 17, ICMP : 1, IPv6-ICMP : 58, GRE : 47, ESP : 50, AH : 51, SCTP : 132

list.name: ipv
list.label: IP version
list.description: Address family of the flow, derived from the stored address form (IPv4 flows are stored IPv4-mapped) — reliable even when the exporter does not fill the ipVersion field. Applies to every panel.

list.name: src
list.label: Source address
list.description: Exact source IP to match (IPv4 or IPv6). Empty = any source. The conversations table and the Distinct-conversations stat match this on either end of the conversation.

list.name: dst
list.label: Destination address
list.description: Exact destination IP to match (IPv4 or IPv6). Empty = any destination. The conversations table and the Distinct-conversations stat match this on either end of the conversation.

list.name: src_port
list.label: Source port
list.description: Exact source port to match (0-65535). Empty = any port. The conversations table and the Distinct-conversations stat match this on either end of the conversation.

list.name: dst_port
list.label: Destination port
list.description: Exact destination port to match (0-65535). Empty = any port. The conversations table and the Distinct-conversations stat match this on either end of the conversation.

panels.title: Matched volume
panels.description: Total bytes carried by flows matching the current filters over the selected range. This is the size of the slice you are looking at — if it is far larger than expected, the filters are not as tight as you think.

targets.rawSql: SELECT sum(bytes) AS "Matched volume" FROM ${database}.flows WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND $__conditionalAll(tenant IN (${tenant:singlequote}), $tenant) AND $__conditionalAll(zone IN (${zone:singlequote}), $zone) AND $__conditionalAll(exporterAddr IN (${exporter:singlequote}), $exporter) AND $__conditionalAll(ifNull(application, 'unclassified') IN (${application:singlequote}), $application) AND $__conditionalAll(protocol IN (${l4:csv}), $l4) AND $__conditionalAll(if(srcAddr BETWEEN toIPv6('::ffff:0.0.0.0') AND toIPv6('::ffff:255.255.255.255'), 4, 6) IN (${ipv:csv}), $ipv) AND (${src:sqlstring} = '' OR srcAddr = toIPv6OrNull(${src:sqlstring})) AND (${dst:sqlstring} = '' OR dstAddr = toIPv6OrNull(${dst:sqlstring})) AND (${src_port:sqlstring} = '' OR srcPort = toUInt16OrNull(${src_port:sqlstring})) AND (${dst_port:sqlstring} = '' OR dstPort = toUInt16OrNull(${dst_port:sqlstring}))

panels.title: Average rate of the slice
panels.description: Matched volume divided by the selected range — the mean rate of this slice. A burst investigation should switch to the throughput panel below; a mean hides the spike.

targets.rawSql: SELECT sum(bytes) * 8 / greatest(1, dateDiff('second', $__fromTime, $__toTime)) AS "Average rate" FROM ${database}.flows WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND $__conditionalAll(tenant IN (${tenant:singlequote}), $tenant) AND $__conditionalAll(zone IN (${zone:singlequote}), $zone) AND $__conditionalAll(exporterAddr IN (${exporter:singlequote}), $exporter) AND $__conditionalAll(ifNull(application, 'unclassified') IN (${application:singlequote}), $application) AND $__conditionalAll(protocol IN (${l4:csv}), $l4) AND $__conditionalAll(if(srcAddr BETWEEN toIPv6('::ffff:0.0.0.0') AND toIPv6('::ffff:255.255.255.255'), 4, 6) IN (${ipv:csv}), $ipv) AND (${src:sqlstring} = '' OR srcAddr = toIPv6OrNull(${src:sqlstring})) AND (${dst:sqlstring} = '' OR dstAddr = toIPv6OrNull(${dst:sqlstring})) AND (${src_port:sqlstring} = '' OR srcPort = toUInt16OrNull(${src_port:sqlstring})) AND (${dst_port:sqlstring} = '' OR dstPort = toUInt16OrNull(${dst_port:sqlstring}))

panels.title: Flow records matched
panels.description: Number of flow records behind every panel on this dashboard. Near the 1000-record cap of the raw table below means the raw view is truncated; low counts mean the aggregates are built on thin evidence.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count() AS "Flow records" FROM ${database}.flows WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND $__conditionalAll(tenant IN (${tenant:singlequote}), $tenant) AND $__conditionalAll(zone IN (${zone:singlequote}), $zone) AND $__conditionalAll(exporterAddr IN (${exporter:singlequote}), $exporter) AND $__conditionalAll(ifNull(application, 'unclassified') IN (${application:singlequote}), $application) AND $__conditionalAll(protocol IN (${l4:csv}), $l4) AND $__conditionalAll(if(srcAddr BETWEEN toIPv6('::ffff:0.0.0.0') AND toIPv6('::ffff:255.255.255.255'), 4, 6) IN (${ipv:csv}), $ipv) AND (${src:sqlstring} = '' OR srcAddr = toIPv6OrNull(${src:sqlstring})) AND (${dst:sqlstring} = '' OR dstAddr = toIPv6OrNull(${dst:sqlstring})) AND (${src_port:sqlstring} = '' OR srcPort = toUInt16OrNull(${src_port:sqlstring})) AND (${dst_port:sqlstring} = '' OR dstPort = toUInt16OrNull(${dst_port:sqlstring}))

panels.title: Distinct conversations
panels.description: Unique conversations in the slice: host pair, application, and service port, folded across direction — the same row definition and the same either-end filter matching as the conversations table below, so TCP/UDP connections that differ only in their ephemeral port count once. One host, many conversations = fan-out (scanning, crawling, or a busy client); many hosts, one conversation shape = a common service.

targets.rawSql: SELECT uniqExact((if(srcAddr < dstAddr, srcAddr, dstAddr), if(srcAddr < dstAddr, dstAddr, srcAddr), protocol, ifNull(application, 'unclassified'), multiIf(protocol NOT IN (6, 17, 132), 0, least(srcPort, dstPort) >= 32768, 0, least(srcPort, dstPort)))) AS "Conversations" FROM ${database}.flows WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND $__conditionalAll(tenant IN (${tenant:singlequote}), $tenant) AND $__conditionalAll(zone IN (${zone:singlequote}), $zone) AND $__conditionalAll(exporterAddr IN (${exporter:singlequote}), $exporter) AND $__conditionalAll(ifNull(application, 'unclassified') IN (${application:singlequote}), $application) AND $__conditionalAll(protocol IN (${l4:csv}), $l4) AND $__conditionalAll(if(srcAddr BETWEEN toIPv6('::ffff:0.0.0.0') AND toIPv6('::ffff:255.255.255.255'), 4, 6) IN (${ipv:csv}), $ipv) AND (${src:sqlstring} = '' OR srcAddr = toIPv6OrNull(${src:sqlstring}) OR dstAddr = toIPv6OrNull(${src:sqlstring})) AND (${dst:sqlstring} = '' OR srcAddr = toIPv6OrNull(${dst:sqlstring}) OR dstAddr = toIPv6OrNull(${dst:sqlstring})) AND (${src_port:sqlstring} = '' OR srcPort = toUInt16OrNull(${src_port:sqlstring}) OR dstPort = toUInt16OrNull(${src_port:sqlstring})) AND (${dst_port:sqlstring} = '' OR srcPort = toUInt16OrNull(${dst_port:sqlstring}) OR dstPort = toUInt16OrNull(${dst_port:sqlstring}))

panels.title: Throughput of the slice — by application
panels.description: Traffic rate of the matched flows, stacked by classified application (top 10 by volume, remainder as Other), bucket size follows the zoom level automatically (never finer than 1 minute, the flow-export resolution). This is where a burst shows its shape and its owner: note when it starts, then tighten the address/port filters until only the burst remains.

targets.rawSql:
WITH top AS (SELECT ifNull(application, 'unclassified') AS dim FROM ${database}.flows WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND $__conditionalAll(tenant IN (${tenant:singlequote}), $tenant) AND $__conditionalAll(zone IN (${zone:singlequote}), $zone) AND $__conditionalAll(exporterAddr IN (${exporter:singlequote}), $exporter) AND $__conditionalAll(ifNull(application, 'unclassified') IN (${application:singlequote}), $application) AND $__conditionalAll(protocol IN (${l4:csv}), $l4) AND $__conditionalAll(if(srcAddr BETWEEN toIPv6('::ffff:0.0.0.0') AND toIPv6('::ffff:255.255.255.255'), 4, 6) IN (${ipv:csv}), $ipv) AND (${src:sqlstring} = '' OR srcAddr = toIPv6OrNull(${src:sqlstring})) AND (${dst:sqlstring} = '' OR dstAddr = toIPv6OrNull(${dst:sqlstring})) AND (${src_port:sqlstring} = '' OR srcPort = toUInt16OrNull(${src_port:sqlstring})) AND (${dst_port:sqlstring} = '' OR dstPort = toUInt16OrNull(${dst_port:sqlstring})) GROUP BY dim ORDER BY sum(bytes) DESC LIMIT 10)
SELECT timestamp AS time,
       if(ifNull(application, 'unclassified') IN (SELECT dim FROM top), ifNull(application, 'unclassified'), 'Other') AS series,
       sum(bytes) * 8 / $__interval_s AS bps
FROM ${database}.samples(ival = $__interval_s)
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND $__conditionalAll(tenant IN (${tenant:singlequote}), $tenant) AND $__conditionalAll(zone IN (${zone:singlequote}), $zone) AND $__conditionalAll(exporterAddr IN (${exporter:singlequote}), $exporter) AND $__conditionalAll(ifNull(application, 'unclassified') IN (${application:singlequote}), $application) AND $__conditionalAll(protocol IN (${l4:csv}), $l4) AND $__conditionalAll(if(srcAddr BETWEEN toIPv6('::ffff:0.0.0.0') AND toIPv6('::ffff:255.255.255.255'), 4, 6) IN (${ipv:csv}), $ipv) AND (${src:sqlstring} = '' OR srcAddr = toIPv6OrNull(${src:sqlstring})) AND (${dst:sqlstring} = '' OR dstAddr = toIPv6OrNull(${dst:sqlstring})) AND (${src_port:sqlstring} = '' OR srcPort = toUInt16OrNull(${src_port:sqlstring})) AND (${dst_port:sqlstring} = '' OR dstPort = toUInt16OrNull(${dst_port:sqlstring})) AND lastSwitched >= $__fromTime AND deltaSwitched <= $__toTime + INTERVAL $__interval_s SECOND AND flow.timestamp >= $__fromTime - INTERVAL 1 HOUR AND flow.timestamp <= $__toTime + INTERVAL 1 HOUR
GROUP BY time, series
ORDER BY time

panels.title: L4 protocol mix
panels.description: Bytes in the slice by IP protocol, largest first. Normal traffic is dominated by TCP and UDP; meaningful volume on anything else (GRE, ESP, ICMP) is either tunnels and VPNs or something worth explaining.

targets.rawSql: SELECT transform(protocol, [1, 2, 6, 17, 41, 47, 50, 51, 58, 89, 132], ['ICMP', 'IGMP', 'TCP', 'UDP', 'IPv6', 'GRE', 'ESP', 'AH', 'IPv6-ICMP', 'OSPFIGP', 'SCTP'], concat('proto-', toString(protocol))) AS "Protocol", sum(bytes) AS "Bytes" FROM ${database}.flows WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND $__conditionalAll(tenant IN (${tenant:singlequote}), $tenant) AND $__conditionalAll(zone IN (${zone:singlequote}), $zone) AND $__conditionalAll(exporterAddr IN (${exporter:singlequote}), $exporter) AND $__conditionalAll(ifNull(application, 'unclassified') IN (${application:singlequote}), $application) AND $__conditionalAll(protocol IN (${l4:csv}), $l4) AND $__conditionalAll(if(srcAddr BETWEEN toIPv6('::ffff:0.0.0.0') AND toIPv6('::ffff:255.255.255.255'), 4, 6) IN (${ipv:csv}), $ipv) AND (${src:sqlstring} = '' OR srcAddr = toIPv6OrNull(${src:sqlstring})) AND (${dst:sqlstring} = '' OR dstAddr = toIPv6OrNull(${dst:sqlstring})) AND (${src_port:sqlstring} = '' OR srcPort = toUInt16OrNull(${src_port:sqlstring})) AND (${dst_port:sqlstring} = '' OR dstPort = toUInt16OrNull(${dst_port:sqlstring})) GROUP BY protocol ORDER BY "Bytes" DESC LIMIT 8

panels.title: TCP flag distribution
panels.description: How many TCP flows in the slice carry each flag (a flow usually carries several). Healthy traffic shows ACK highest with SYN and FIN in proportion; SYN far above ACK is connection attempts that never establish — scanning or a service refusing connections; elevated RST points at resets from a peer or a middlebox.

targets.rawSql: SELECT countIf(bitAnd(tcpFlags, 2) != 0) AS "SYN", countIf(bitAnd(tcpFlags, 16) != 0) AS "ACK", countIf(bitAnd(tcpFlags, 1) != 0) AS "FIN", countIf(bitAnd(tcpFlags, 4) != 0) AS "RST", countIf(bitAnd(tcpFlags, 8) != 0) AS "PSH", countIf(bitAnd(tcpFlags, 32) != 0) AS "URG" FROM ${database}.flows WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND $__conditionalAll(tenant IN (${tenant:singlequote}), $tenant) AND $__conditionalAll(zone IN (${zone:singlequote}), $zone) AND $__conditionalAll(exporterAddr IN (${exporter:singlequote}), $exporter) AND $__conditionalAll(ifNull(application, 'unclassified') IN (${application:singlequote}), $application) AND $__conditionalAll(protocol IN (${l4:csv}), $l4) AND $__conditionalAll(if(srcAddr BETWEEN toIPv6('::ffff:0.0.0.0') AND toIPv6('::ffff:255.255.255.255'), 4, 6) IN (${ipv:csv}), $ipv) AND (${src:sqlstring} = '' OR srcAddr = toIPv6OrNull(${src:sqlstring})) AND (${dst:sqlstring} = '' OR dstAddr = toIPv6OrNull(${dst:sqlstring})) AND (${src_port:sqlstring} = '' OR srcPort = toUInt16OrNull(${src_port:sqlstring})) AND (${dst_port:sqlstring} = '' OR dstPort = toUInt16OrNull(${dst_port:sqlstring})) AND protocol = 6

panels.title: DSCP mix
panels.description: Bytes in the slice by DSCP class (the top 6 bits of the ToS byte), largest first. Tells you whether the traffic is marked for priority treatment: bulk data in EF or voice in best-effort are QoS misconfigurations that flow records catch before users do.

targets.rawSql: SELECT concat(toString(bitShiftRight(tos, 2)), ' - ', transform(bitShiftRight(tos, 2), [0, 8, 10, 14, 18, 22, 26, 28, 34, 36, 46, 48, 56], ['BE', 'CS1', 'AF11', 'AF13', 'AF21', 'AF23', 'AF31', 'AF32', 'AF41', 'AF42', 'EF', 'CS6', 'CS7'], 'other')) AS "DSCP", sum(bytes) AS "Bytes" FROM ${database}.flows WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND $__conditionalAll(tenant IN (${tenant:singlequote}), $tenant) AND $__conditionalAll(zone IN (${zone:singlequote}), $zone) AND $__conditionalAll(exporterAddr IN (${exporter:singlequote}), $exporter) AND $__conditionalAll(ifNull(application, 'unclassified') IN (${application:singlequote}), $application) AND $__conditionalAll(protocol IN (${l4:csv}), $l4) AND $__conditionalAll(if(srcAddr BETWEEN toIPv6('::ffff:0.0.0.0') AND toIPv6('::ffff:255.255.255.255'), 4, 6) IN (${ipv:csv}), $ipv) AND (${src:sqlstring} = '' OR srcAddr = toIPv6OrNull(${src:sqlstring})) AND (${dst:sqlstring} = '' OR dstAddr = toIPv6OrNull(${dst:sqlstring})) AND (${src_port:sqlstring} = '' OR srcPort = toUInt16OrNull(${src_port:sqlstring})) AND (${dst_port:sqlstring} = '' OR dstPort = toUInt16OrNull(${dst_port:sqlstring})) GROUP BY bitShiftRight(tos, 2) ORDER BY "Bytes" DESC LIMIT 8

panels.title: Top $limit source hosts in the slice
panels.description: Sources ranked by bytes sent within the matched flows — reverse-DNS name where resolved (hover for the IP address), address otherwise. High Peers with modest Bytes reads as scanning; high Bytes to one peer is a transfer. Click a source to set it as this dashboard's Source filter — every panel tightens to that host, other filters and time preserved.

targets.rawSql: SELECT ifNull(any(srcAddrHostname), replaceOne(toString(srcAddr), '::ffff:', '')) AS "Source", replaceOne(toString(srcAddr), '::ffff:', '') AS "Address", if(isNotNull(any(srcAddrHostname)), concat(replaceOne(toString(srcAddr), '::ffff:', ''), ' — filter the slice to this host'), 'Filter the slice to this host') AS "Tip", sum(bytes) AS "Bytes", sum(packets) AS "Packets", uniqExact(dstAddr) AS "Peers" FROM ${database}.flows WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND $__conditionalAll(tenant IN (${tenant:singlequote}), $tenant) AND $__conditionalAll(zone IN (${zone:singlequote}), $zone) AND $__conditionalAll(exporterAddr IN (${exporter:singlequote}), $exporter) AND $__conditionalAll(ifNull(application, 'unclassified') IN (${application:singlequote}), $application) AND $__conditionalAll(protocol IN (${l4:csv}), $l4) AND $__conditionalAll(if(srcAddr BETWEEN toIPv6('::ffff:0.0.0.0') AND toIPv6('::ffff:255.255.255.255'), 4, 6) IN (${ipv:csv}), $ipv) AND (${src:sqlstring} = '' OR srcAddr = toIPv6OrNull(${src:sqlstring})) AND (${dst:sqlstring} = '' OR dstAddr = toIPv6OrNull(${dst:sqlstring})) AND (${src_port:sqlstring} = '' OR srcPort = toUInt16OrNull(${src_port:sqlstring})) AND (${dst_port:sqlstring} = '' OR dstPort = toUInt16OrNull(${dst_port:sqlstring})) GROUP BY srcAddr ORDER BY "Bytes" DESC LIMIT $limit

panels.title: Top $limit destination hosts in the slice
panels.description: Destinations ranked by bytes received within the matched flows — reverse-DNS name where resolved (hover for the IP address), address otherwise. One destination drawing outsized volume is the sink to verify (backup target, update server, or somewhere data should not be going). Click a destination to set it as this dashboard's Destination filter — every panel tightens to that host.

targets.rawSql: SELECT ifNull(any(dstAddrHostname), replaceOne(toString(dstAddr), '::ffff:', '')) AS "Destination", replaceOne(toString(dstAddr), '::ffff:', '') AS "Address", if(isNotNull(any(dstAddrHostname)), concat(replaceOne(toString(dstAddr), '::ffff:', ''), ' — filter the slice to this host'), 'Filter the slice to this host') AS "Tip", sum(bytes) AS "Bytes", sum(packets) AS "Packets", uniqExact(srcAddr) AS "Peers" FROM ${database}.flows WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND $__conditionalAll(tenant IN (${tenant:singlequote}), $tenant) AND $__conditionalAll(zone IN (${zone:singlequote}), $zone) AND $__conditionalAll(exporterAddr IN (${exporter:singlequote}), $exporter) AND $__conditionalAll(ifNull(application, 'unclassified') IN (${application:singlequote}), $application) AND $__conditionalAll(protocol IN (${l4:csv}), $l4) AND $__conditionalAll(if(srcAddr BETWEEN toIPv6('::ffff:0.0.0.0') AND toIPv6('::ffff:255.255.255.255'), 4, 6) IN (${ipv:csv}), $ipv) AND (${src:sqlstring} = '' OR srcAddr = toIPv6OrNull(${src:sqlstring})) AND (${dst:sqlstring} = '' OR dstAddr = toIPv6OrNull(${dst:sqlstring})) AND (${src_port:sqlstring} = '' OR srcPort = toUInt16OrNull(${src_port:sqlstring})) AND (${dst_port:sqlstring} = '' OR dstPort = toUInt16OrNull(${dst_port:sqlstring})) GROUP BY dstAddr ORDER BY "Bytes" DESC LIMIT $limit

panels.title: Top $limit conversations in the slice
panels.description: One row per conversation: both directions of a host pair folded together, keyed by application and service port — TCP/UDP connections that differ only in their ephemeral port collapse into one row. Initiator is inferred from the ephemeral-port side of the socket, cross-checked against the earliest flow start; a trailing ? marks uncertain inference (both ports high/ephemeral, symmetric ports such as NTP's 123↔123, connections in both orientations between the pair, or the signals disagree) — treat those as a hint, not a fact. Hosts show their reverse-DNS name where resolved (hover for the IP address), the address otherwise. Application shows the classifier's name with the service — protocol/port of the well-known side (below 32768, where the common ephemeral ranges start), or protocol/dynamic when both sides are high ports — in the hover; unclassified conversations show the service directly. Bytes → is volume sent by the initiator host, Bytes ← the return path. The geo columns show each end's AS (organisation name where known, ASnnn otherwise), country and city from the flow enrichment; — means no geo data, which is normal for private addresses. Here and in the Distinct-conversations stat, the address and port filters match either end of the conversation, so a pinned pair shows both directions — the other panels stay directional. Click an initiator or responder to set it as the Source/Destination filter, or an application to set the Application filter.

targets.rawSql:
WITH conv AS (
  SELECT
    if(srcAddr < dstAddr, srcAddr, dstAddr) AS hostA,
    if(srcAddr < dstAddr, dstAddr, srcAddr) AS hostB,
    protocol AS proto,
    ifNull(application, 'unclassified') AS app,
    multiIf(protocol NOT IN (6, 17, 132), 0, least(srcPort, dstPort) >= 32768, 0, least(srcPort, dstPort)) AS svcPort,
    any(if(srcAddr <= dstAddr, srcAddrHostname, dstAddrHostname)) AS hostAName,
    any(if(srcAddr <= dstAddr, dstAddrHostname, srcAddrHostname)) AS hostBName,
    sumIf(bytes, srcAddr <= dstAddr) AS bytesAB,
    sumIf(bytes, srcAddr > dstAddr) AS bytesBA,
    max(if(srcAddr <= dstAddr, srcAs, dstAs)) AS asA,
    max(if(srcAddr <= dstAddr, dstAs, srcAs)) AS asB,
    any(nullIf(if(srcAddr <= dstAddr, srcAsOrg, dstAsOrg), '')) AS asOrgA,
    any(nullIf(if(srcAddr <= dstAddr, dstAsOrg, srcAsOrg), '')) AS asOrgB,
    any(nullIf(if(srcAddr <= dstAddr, srcCountry, dstCountry), '')) AS countryA,
    any(nullIf(if(srcAddr <= dstAddr, dstCountry, srcCountry), '')) AS countryB,
    any(nullIf(if(srcAddr <= dstAddr, srcCity, dstCity), '')) AS cityA,
    any(nullIf(if(srcAddr <= dstAddr, dstCity, srcCity), '')) AS cityB,
    argMin(srcAddr, firstSwitched) AS timeInit,
    min(multiIf(svcPort = 0 OR srcPort = dstPort, NULL, srcPort > dstPort, srcAddr, dstAddr)) AS portInit,
    max(multiIf(svcPort = 0 OR srcPort = dstPort, NULL, srcPort > dstPort, srcAddr, dstAddr)) AS portInitMax
  FROM ${database}.flows
  WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND $__conditionalAll(tenant IN (${tenant:singlequote}), $tenant) AND $__conditionalAll(zone IN (${zone:singlequote}), $zone) AND $__conditionalAll(exporterAddr IN (${exporter:singlequote}), $exporter) AND $__conditionalAll(ifNull(application, 'unclassified') IN (${application:singlequote}), $application) AND $__conditionalAll(protocol IN (${l4:csv}), $l4) AND $__conditionalAll(if(srcAddr BETWEEN toIPv6('::ffff:0.0.0.0') AND toIPv6('::ffff:255.255.255.255'), 4, 6) IN (${ipv:csv}), $ipv) AND (${src:sqlstring} = '' OR srcAddr = toIPv6OrNull(${src:sqlstring}) OR dstAddr = toIPv6OrNull(${src:sqlstring})) AND (${dst:sqlstring} = '' OR srcAddr = toIPv6OrNull(${dst:sqlstring}) OR dstAddr = toIPv6OrNull(${dst:sqlstring})) AND (${src_port:sqlstring} = '' OR srcPort = toUInt16OrNull(${src_port:sqlstring}) OR dstPort = toUInt16OrNull(${src_port:sqlstring})) AND (${dst_port:sqlstring} = '' OR srcPort = toUInt16OrNull(${dst_port:sqlstring}) OR dstPort = toUInt16OrNull(${dst_port:sqlstring}))
  GROUP BY hostA, hostB, proto, app, svcPort
  ORDER BY bytesAB + bytesBA DESC
  LIMIT $limit
), oriented AS (
  SELECT *,
    ifNull(portInit, timeInit) AS initAddr,
    ((portInit IS NULL) OR ifNull(portInit != portInitMax, 0) OR ifNull(portInit != timeInit, 0)) AS lowConfidence,
    transform(proto, [1, 2, 6, 17, 41, 47, 50, 51, 58, 89, 132], ['ICMP', 'IGMP', 'TCP', 'UDP', 'IPv6', 'GRE', 'ESP', 'AH', 'IPv6-ICMP', 'OSPFIGP', 'SCTP'], concat('proto-', toString(proto))) AS protoName,
    multiIf(proto NOT IN (6, 17, 132), protoName, svcPort = 0, concat(protoName, '/dynamic'), concat(protoName, '/', toString(svcPort))) AS svc,
    if(initAddr = hostA, hostAName, hostBName) AS initName,
    if(initAddr = hostA, hostBName, hostAName) AS respName,
    replaceOne(toString(if(initAddr = hostA, hostA, hostB)), '::ffff:', '') AS initIp,
    replaceOne(toString(if(initAddr = hostA, hostB, hostA)), '::ffff:', '') AS respIp,
    arrayStringConcat(arrayFilter(x -> x != '', [ifNull(if(initAddr = hostA, asOrgA, asOrgB), if(if(initAddr = hostA, asA, asB) = 0, '', concat('AS', toString(if(initAddr = hostA, asA, asB))))), ifNull(if(initAddr = hostA, countryA, countryB), ''), ifNull(if(initAddr = hostA, cityA, cityB), '')]), ' · ') AS initGeo,
    arrayStringConcat(arrayFilter(x -> x != '', [ifNull(if(initAddr = hostA, asOrgB, asOrgA), if(if(initAddr = hostA, asB, asA) = 0, '', concat('AS', toString(if(initAddr = hostA, asB, asA))))), ifNull(if(initAddr = hostA, countryB, countryA), ''), ifNull(if(initAddr = hostA, cityB, cityA), '')]), ' · ') AS respGeo
  FROM conv
)
SELECT
  concat(ifNull(initName, initIp), if(lowConfidence, ' ?', '')) AS "Initiator",
  initIp AS "Initiator addr",
  if(isNotNull(initName), concat(initIp, ' — filter the slice to this host'), 'Filter the slice to this host') AS "Initiator tip",
  if(initGeo = '', '—', initGeo) AS "Initiator geo",
  ifNull(respName, respIp) AS "Responder",
  respIp AS "Responder addr",
  if(isNotNull(respName), concat(respIp, ' — filter the slice to this host'), 'Filter the slice to this host') AS "Responder tip",
  if(respGeo = '', '—', respGeo) AS "Responder geo",
  if(app != 'unclassified', app, svc) AS "Application",
  app AS "Application value",
  if(app != 'unclassified', concat(svc, ' — filter the slice to this application'), 'Filter the slice to this application') AS "Application tip",
  if(initAddr = hostA, bytesAB, bytesBA) AS "Bytes →",
  if(initAddr = hostA, bytesBA, bytesAB) AS "Bytes ←"
FROM oriented
ORDER BY bytesAB + bytesBA DESC

panels.title: Observation paths: Exporter - Interface - Direction - Application
panels.description: Where was the sliced traffic observed: which exporter, on which interface, in which direction, speaking which application — byte-weighted, top $limit paths. The same conversation appears once per exporter/interface/direction it was observed on, so an asymmetric path (in via one interface, out via another) shows as two bands. Interface and direction are observation-point relative: ingress = sampled entering the interface, egress = leaving it; exporters that tag only one side populate only that band. Identify who is behind a band in the conversations table above. When nothing matches the current filters, the diagram shows a single 'no flows match the filters' band instead of failing. Address and port filters match either end, like the conversations table.

targets.rawSql:
WITH paths AS (
SELECT
  if(exporterName != '', exporterName, exporterAddr) AS "Exporter",
  concat("Exporter", ' - ', if(direction = 'EGRESS', ifNull(outputSnmpIfName, concat('if', toString(outputSnmp))), ifNull(inputSnmpIfName, concat('if', toString(inputSnmp))))) AS "Interface",
  multiIf(direction = 'INGRESS', 'ingress', direction = 'EGRESS', 'egress', 'unknown') AS "Direction",
  ifNull(application, 'unclassified') AS "Application",
  sum(bytes) AS "Bytes"
FROM ${database}.flows
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND $__conditionalAll(tenant IN (${tenant:singlequote}), $tenant) AND $__conditionalAll(zone IN (${zone:singlequote}), $zone) AND $__conditionalAll(exporterAddr IN (${exporter:singlequote}), $exporter) AND $__conditionalAll(ifNull(application, 'unclassified') IN (${application:singlequote}), $application) AND $__conditionalAll(protocol IN (${l4:csv}), $l4) AND $__conditionalAll(if(srcAddr BETWEEN toIPv6('::ffff:0.0.0.0') AND toIPv6('::ffff:255.255.255.255'), 4, 6) IN (${ipv:csv}), $ipv) AND (${src:sqlstring} = '' OR srcAddr = toIPv6OrNull(${src:sqlstring}) OR dstAddr = toIPv6OrNull(${src:sqlstring})) AND (${dst:sqlstring} = '' OR srcAddr = toIPv6OrNull(${dst:sqlstring}) OR dstAddr = toIPv6OrNull(${dst:sqlstring})) AND (${src_port:sqlstring} = '' OR srcPort = toUInt16OrNull(${src_port:sqlstring}) OR dstPort = toUInt16OrNull(${src_port:sqlstring})) AND (${dst_port:sqlstring} = '' OR srcPort = toUInt16OrNull(${dst_port:sqlstring}) OR dstPort = toUInt16OrNull(${dst_port:sqlstring}))
GROUP BY "Exporter", "Interface", "Direction", "Application"
ORDER BY "Bytes" DESC
LIMIT $limit
)
SELECT * FROM paths
UNION ALL
SELECT 'no flows match the filters', 'no flows match the filters', 'no flows match the filters', 'no flows match the filters', 1 WHERE (SELECT count() FROM paths) = 0

panels.title: Locality matrix
panels.description: Bytes in the slice broken down by source and destination locality (PRIVATE = RFC1918/ULA, PUBLIC = everything else). PRIVATE to PUBLIC is traffic leaving the network — during an exfiltration scare, tighten the filters and watch this cell; PUBLIC to PRIVATE with no matching outbound is unsolicited inbound.

targets.rawSql: SELECT toString(srcLocality) AS "Source locality", toString(dstLocality) AS "Destination locality", sum(bytes) AS "Bytes" FROM ${database}.flows WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND $__conditionalAll(tenant IN (${tenant:singlequote}), $tenant) AND $__conditionalAll(zone IN (${zone:singlequote}), $zone) AND $__conditionalAll(exporterAddr IN (${exporter:singlequote}), $exporter) AND $__conditionalAll(ifNull(application, 'unclassified') IN (${application:singlequote}), $application) AND $__conditionalAll(protocol IN (${l4:csv}), $l4) AND $__conditionalAll(if(srcAddr BETWEEN toIPv6('::ffff:0.0.0.0') AND toIPv6('::ffff:255.255.255.255'), 4, 6) IN (${ipv:csv}), $ipv) AND (${src:sqlstring} = '' OR srcAddr = toIPv6OrNull(${src:sqlstring})) AND (${dst:sqlstring} = '' OR dstAddr = toIPv6OrNull(${dst:sqlstring})) AND (${src_port:sqlstring} = '' OR srcPort = toUInt16OrNull(${src_port:sqlstring})) AND (${dst_port:sqlstring} = '' OR dstPort = toUInt16OrNull(${dst_port:sqlstring})) GROUP BY srcLocality, dstLocality ORDER BY "Bytes" DESC

panels.title: Raw flow records — newest first, capped at 1000
panels.description: The unaggregated evidence: the most recent 1000 flow records matching the filters, newest first. If 'Flow records matched' above exceeds 1000 this view is truncated — tighten the filters until it fits. This panel scans the raw table; on wide-open filters over long ranges it is the most expensive panel here.

targets.rawSql: SELECT timestamp AS "Time", if(exporterName != '', exporterName, exporterAddr) AS "Exporter", ifNull(srcAddrHostname, replaceOne(toString(srcAddr), '::ffff:', '')) AS "Source", srcPort AS "SPort", ifNull(dstAddrHostname, replaceOne(toString(dstAddr), '::ffff:', '')) AS "Destination", dstPort AS "DPort", transform(protocol, [1, 2, 6, 17, 41, 47, 50, 51, 58, 89, 132], ['ICMP', 'IGMP', 'TCP', 'UDP', 'IPv6', 'GRE', 'ESP', 'AH', 'IPv6-ICMP', 'OSPFIGP', 'SCTP'], concat('proto-', toString(protocol))) AS "Proto", ifNull(application, 'unclassified') AS "Application", bytes AS "Bytes", packets AS "Packets" FROM ${database}.flows WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND $__conditionalAll(tenant IN (${tenant:singlequote}), $tenant) AND $__conditionalAll(zone IN (${zone:singlequote}), $zone) AND $__conditionalAll(exporterAddr IN (${exporter:singlequote}), $exporter) AND $__conditionalAll(ifNull(application, 'unclassified') IN (${application:singlequote}), $application) AND $__conditionalAll(protocol IN (${l4:csv}), $l4) AND $__conditionalAll(if(srcAddr BETWEEN toIPv6('::ffff:0.0.0.0') AND toIPv6('::ffff:255.255.255.255'), 4, 6) IN (${ipv:csv}), $ipv) AND (${src:sqlstring} = '' OR srcAddr = toIPv6OrNull(${src:sqlstring})) AND (${dst:sqlstring} = '' OR dstAddr = toIPv6OrNull(${dst:sqlstring})) AND (${src_port:sqlstring} = '' OR srcPort = toUInt16OrNull(${src_port:sqlstring})) AND (${dst_port:sqlstring} = '' OR dstPort = toUInt16OrNull(${dst_port:sqlstring})) ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1000
